observations: Single photo shows a bare engine block sitting on a concrete/paved surface, not mounted in a vehicle.
Visible components: timing belt, pulleys, alternator, intake manifold, oil cap, wiring harness.
No engine code, casting number, VIN, or model plate is legible anywhere in the photo.
A watermark reading 'NWAKAONAOBIEZE' is overlaid on the image, likely the seller's business name, not an identifying mark of the engine itself.
No start-up, compression test, or video evidence of the engine running.
No photos of the underside, engine number stamp area, or accessories (loom, sensors) included.

claims.evidence: No Toyota badge, casting mark, or engine code visible in photo 0 to confirm make/model.

claims.claim: 5x old model (implying 5S-FE or similar engine code)
claims.evidence: No engine code stamp or plate legible in photo 0.
No import documents, shipping tags, or markings shown.
No warranty card, receipt, or shop signage shown in photo.

risks.risk: Engine may not actually be a Camry engine or may not match the specific '5x' code claimed, which changes compatibility and price.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code/casting stamp (usually on the block near the starter or head) clearly readable.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unverified used 4-cylinder engine, not as a specific confirmed Camry 5S-FE unit.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal faults (compression, knocking, oil leaks) since no test is shown.
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine starting and running, ideally with sound, plus a compression test reading.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (wiring harness, sensors, ECU) could add extra cost to make it usable.
risks.proof: Full set of photos showing all sides of the engine including connector ends and sensor locations.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare block only, assuming missing accessories.

risks.risk: 'Guarantee' claim could be false or unenforceable without a written agreement.
risks.proof: Photo of a physical warranty/guarantee note or shop receipt with terms.
risks.if_unproven: treated as no guarantee for pricing purposes.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code/casting number stamp.
Video of the engine starting and idling.
Photos from additional angles (rear, underside, connector/sensor areas).
Any paperwork proving import status or prior guarantee/warranty.
response.reason: The specific engine model that determines price cannot be read from the single photo, and no functional test is shown, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without the engine code and a running/compression proof.
